IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every mutation of the ontology, entity, relationship, command, interaction and operations APIs. A repeat with the same body replays the stored result; the same key with a different body is 409 idempotency_mismatch.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

AccessImpact.description: A type whose access was tightened (P7): how many active entities become subject-scoped, and how many principals lose sight of how many of them.
AccessImpact.title: AccessImpact

ActivityOut.description: Ids and counts only (T11): never memory content from a private scope.
ActivityOut.title: ActivityOut

AssertionIn.description: An optional structured claim: `predicate` is a short token, `object` a scalar. It lets the platform notice a contradiction between two memories.
AssertionIn.title: AssertionIn

CitationOut.description: A compact handle for one source, resolvable on demand through an endpoint whose own authorisation applies.
CitationOut.title: CitationOut

ContextBuildIn.description: `POST /v1/context/build` (§5.1). `task` is untrusted text: it is used to retrieve and is never stored in plaintext (the trace keeps a keyed hash).
ContextBuildIn.title: ContextBuildIn

DerivedSummaryOut.description: Graphiti's running summary of an entity. DERIVED text: it is never a fact source, never used to answer a question, and always labelled so.
DerivedSummaryOut.title: DerivedSummaryOut

EntityRefIn.description: An endpoint: by platform id, or by a strong external identifier (never by name, KGR-02).
EntityRefIn.title: EntityRefIn

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx response. `details` never echoes request values (field paths only).
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

EvidenceOut.description: Why the system holds a fact (KGR-05): a command, or an episode of an interaction. Never content.
EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut

ExternalRef.description: A strong external identifier, resolved at acceptance when possible and otherwise kept UNRESOLVED for P4 identity resolution.
ExternalRef.title: ExternalRef

InteractionIn.description: Validation is per FIELD (not a whole-model check) so every error names its path; `details.fields` never carries a value.
InteractionIn.title: InteractionIn

InteractionRef.description: An interaction behind a review item. The reviewer reads its content through the audited evidence endpoint, never from this list.
InteractionRef.title: InteractionRef

agent_generated.description: AGT-01: produced by an agent. Read it with `evidence_status` (`unverified` until a reviewer approves it).

plaintext.description: The key, shown once. Null on an idempotent replay.
plaintext.title: Plaintext

PreviewOut.description: What a correction would touch, read-only. Counts and ids the caller may see; contexts are counted for admins only.
PreviewOut.title: PreviewOut

ProposalIn.description: `POST /v1/memories/proposals` (blueprint reference §C). `requested_scope` is advisory and always checked against the caller's grants.
ProposalIn.title: ProposalIn

ReviewEntityView.description: One side of an identity comparison. Sensitive attributes are redacted unless the caller may see them.
ReviewEntityView.title: ReviewEntityView

ReviewMemoryView.description:
One memory a review item is about (P5). Filled by the API from kg_memory with the REVIEWER's own visibility, so it never shows a scope or a memory the
reviewer could not open directly.

post.description:
The smallest sufficiently informative, authorised, budgeted, cited context for a task (blueprint 02-domain/05). The workspace and the identity come from the
credential; a body that names them is a 422. With `X-Act-As-Principal` an admin builds as an agent or app of the workspace (Context Lab, audited).

get.description: The effective profiles for this workspace (built-ins overridden by the active ontology): name, caps, sections, modes.
The package re-materialised under YOUR current authorisation: anything no longer visible or active is omitted and counted in `withdrawn`.
The opt-in encrypted snapshot (the task and the rendered text), until it expires. Admin only, audited, never cached.

Why a build chose what it chose: the plan, versions, per-source counts, every authorised candidate with its score, features, tier and exclusion reason, the
token accounting, watermarks and latencies. Metadata only (ids and numbers): the owner of the build and workspace admins only.
The history of corrections: ids, kinds and reason codes for everyone with the action; the reason TEXT only for reviewers and admins.

Preview what a DRAFT would extract from sample interactions, before it is published. Without `confirm` this only estimates tokens and cost (nothing is sent to a
model). With `confirm=true` (and optionally the `simulation_id` of the preview) the run starts in an isolated staging namespace that is removed when it ends; the report
holds counts and type keys only. A `local_only` sample, or one whose consent is withheld, is skipped by policy.
Read-only: recomputes the validation report (including the Graphiti compile check and the rule tests).
